senses.gloss:
गुल गुल, अस्, m. raw or unrefined sugar,
molasses; the glans penis; the clitoris; (आ), f. the
plant Tithymalus Antiquorum; (ई), f. a pill, a bolus,
any small globular substance; small pox; [cf. गुड
and गोल.]
गुल्य, अस्, m. sweetness, a sweet or saccharine taste.

गुलञ्चकन्द गुलञ्चकन्द, अस्, m. an escu-
lent root (Kanda), commonly Kulī; [cf. गुच्छाह्व-
कन्द.]

गुलह गुलह, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people in
Madhya-deśa; [cf. गुडुह, गुरुह, गुलुह.]

गुलिक गुलिक, अस्, m., N. of a hunter;
(आ), f. = गुटिका, a ball; a pearl.
—गुलिका-क्रीडा, f.
playing with a ball, bat and ball, golf, &c.

गुलिङ्क गुलिङ्क, अस्, m. = कुलिङ्कक, a
sparrow.

गुलुच्छ गुलुच्छ or गुलुञ्च or गुलुञ्छ or
गुलुञ्छक, अस्, m. a bunch, a nosegay, a cluster
of blossoms; [cf. गुच्छ, गुत्स, गुलञ्चकन्द.]

गुलुह गुलुह, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people in
Madhya-deśa; [cf. गुडुह, गुरुह, गुलह.]

गुल्गुलु गुल्गुलु, उस्, उ, m. n. bdellium; [cf.
गुग्गुलु.]

गुल्फ गुल्फ, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. गल्),
the ancle; [cf. विगुल्फ and कुल्फ.]
—गुल्फ-
जाह, अम्, n. the root of the ancle.

गुल्म गुल्म, अस्, अम्, m. n. a cluster or
clump of trees, a thicket, a bush, a shrub; a troop
or guard of soldiers, a body of troops, a division of
an army, consisting of 45 foot, 27 horse, 9 chariots,
and 9 elephants; or of 135 foot, 81 horse, 27 cha-
riots, and 27 elephants; a fort, an intrenchment;
disciplining an army, keeping it in a posture of de-
fence; the spleen; a chronic enlargement of the
spleen or as variously situated any glandular enlarge-
ment in the abdomen, as that of the mesenteric
gland &c., so as to be perceived externally; a wharf
or stairs, a Ghaṭ; (ई), f. a cluster or clump or trees,
a multitude of thickets; Emblic Myrobalan; jujube;
small cardamoms; a tent.
—गुल्म-केतु, उस्, m. a
small sort of cane or reed, sorrel.
—गुल्म-केश, अस्,
आ, अम्, having bushy hair.
—गुल्म-मूल, अम्, n.
fresh ginger.
—गुल्म-वल्ली, f. the plant Sarcostemma
Viminale.
—गुल्म-वात, अस्, m. or गुल्मोदर
(˚म-उद्˚), अम्, n. a disease of the spleen.

गुल्मक, अस्, m., N. of a son of the Brāhman
Soma-śarman.

गुल्मिन्, ई, इनी, इ, composed of different divisions
(a force &c.); growing in a clump or cluster,
clustered, bushy; having the spleen, affected by that
disease; (नी), f. a spreading creeper or any creeping
plant.
